ideas.children_he: יוֹסֵף הִתְאַבֵּל עַל אָבִיו וְנָתַן לוֹ כָּבוֹד אַחֲרוֹן.
ideas.children_en: Joseph loved his father very much. He cried and honored him with a special embalming process that took 40 days. The Egyptians mourned for 70 days.

ideas.children_he: יוֹסֵף רָצָה לְקַיֵּם אֶת הַהַבְטָחָה שֶׁנָּתַן לְאָבִיו.
ideas.children_en: Joseph asked Pharaoh's men for permission to bury his father in Canaan as his father requested, and Pharaoh agreed.

ideas.children_he: אֲנָשִׁים רַבִּים לִוּוּ אֶת יַעֲקֹב בְּדַרְכּוֹ הָאַחֲרוֹנָה.
ideas.children_en: Joseph went up with his family, Pharaoh's servants, and horsemen to bury his father. The group was very large to make sure Joseph was safe.

ideas.children_he: הַמִּשְׁפָּחָה נִפְרְדָה מִיַּעֲקֹב וּקְבָרָה אוֹתוֹ בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן.
ideas.children_en: On the long journey to bury his father, they mourned for seven days. People named the place Avel Mitzrayim. Finally, they buried him in the Cave of Machpelah in Canaan.

ideas.children_he: הָאַחִים פָּחֲדוּ שֶׁיּוֹסֵף עֲדַיִן כּוֹעֵס עֲלֵיהֶם.
ideas.children_en: Joseph's brothers were afraid he would hate them after their father died. They sent him a message asking for forgiveness. Joseph cried and saw they were willing to be his servants.

ideas.children_he: יוֹסֵף בָּחַר לֹא לִנְקֹם, אֶלָּא לִדְאֹג לְאֶחָיו וְלִילְדֵיהֶם.
ideas.children_en: Joseph told his brothers not to fear. God alone can forgive, and Joseph would not punish them. He promised to take care of them and their children.

ideas.children_he: לִפְנֵי מוֹתוֹ יוֹסֵף בִּקֵּשׁ שֶׁיִּזְכְּרוּ אוֹתוֹ כְּשֶׁיַּחְזְרוּ לְאֶרֶץ אֲבוֹתֵיהֶם.
ideas.children_en: Joseph lived in Egypt 110 years, saw his great-grandchildren, and promised that when the people leave Egypt, they will take his bones. After he died, they embalmed and buried him in Egypt.
